title: Enigma
plot: Zkoumání transgenderové identity a odkazu prostřednictvím příběhů ikonApril AshleyaAmandy Lear.(HBO Max)

reviews.author: sadlokan
reviews.text: Nedoporučuji macho mužům.Ideály ženské krásy jsou zde redukovány na ideály krásy.(12.08.2025)

reviews.author: TroiMae
reviews.text: “You see the scale of the resistance that April experiences, and the way she’s forever treated as an oddity because of her being so clear about who she was. There’s something fascinating about somebody who’s like: ‘No, I’m just going to be me. I’m going to create who I am from the ground up, and I have no tethers, no allegiance… to historical facts’.”  (Trans trailblazers April Ashley and Amanda Lear celebrated in new HBO doc)(30.06.2025)
